lead_thumbnail_backdrop.source_rule: Use the exact accepted Episode 003 S050 HOME_REST local image, bound by path, SHA-256 and matching uploaded media ID, as the only reference. Never use a Pompeii background, an old remote result superseded by a local correction, or an unapproved parent.

lead_thumbnail_backdrop.prompt: Recompose the accepted Egyptian HOME_A resting-worker illustration as a premium 16:9 thumbnail background. Preserve its flat 2D channel drawing, earthy palette, mudbrick room, low built-in left bench, single support post and simple rear-left doorway. Exactly one adult Egyptian worker in plain light linen reclines on the low bench in the lower-left area, roughly x=8–55% and y=58–90%; the entire torso and legs rest on the bench, head supported on folded fabric, hands and limbs clear and separate. His resting posture must read at small size. A small plain grain container may sit on the floor near the bench as an illustrative link to grain pay, without numbers or markings. Keep the upper-left wall, x=5–62% and y=5–53%, quiet and low-detail for large words added later. Keep the rightmost thirty percent empty and subdued for the Visitor head-and-shoulders artwork added later. Maintain coherent soft upper-left daylight and sufficient tonal contrast between the reclining figure, bench and wall. The image is an illustrative reconstruction of the Ramesside Deir el-Medina community across several reigns, not an exact recorded sick day or historical portrait. No Visitor, orange hoodie or additional person. No modern bed, mattress, hospital, medical cross, pills, thermometer, banknote, coin, crown, fake hieroglyph, readable writing, logo, border or floating text panel. Keep the same illustration style; no photorealism or medieval/Roman architecture. Full-bleed 16:9, 2K.

acceptance.duration: 10:00 minimum, target 10–12 minutes; do not pad silence or unnaturally stretch delivery. If the authored content cannot meet it naturally, report the measured problem to Astra before rewriting.
acceptance.audio: Approximately -14 LUFS within the established tolerance; true peak at or below -1 dBTP. Voice intelligible throughout; effects must fit the scene and stay below narration. Actual listening required.
acceptance.images: Every accepted image/composite inspected; exact parent identity and historical setting retained; source notes correct and readable; no repeated defect knowingly accepted.
acceptance.thumbnail: Owner title plus PAID SICK DAYS?; real inspected Egyptian background; no placeholder label or background; mobile-readable finished composition.
acceptance.evidence: Hashes identify the final video, thumbnail, captions, Shorts and selected inputs; retain paid job IDs, actual costs and the known limitations. Technical success is not a substitute for perceptual review.
acceptance.handover: Mark ready for owner review only when the required executor work is complete. Owner publication approval remains separate.
